quote: We leverage the generalizability of LLMs to automatically generate diverse T2I prompts

We utilized LLMs to sample two types of prompts: unconstrained subject and constrained subject. Table  demonstrates the templates used for sampling T2I prompts. These templates serve as inputs for chat-based LLMs, such as ChatGPT, to generate T2I prompts.
we introduce VLEU (Visual Language Evaluation Understudy) metric
We introduced VLEU, a novel automatic metric to evaluate T2I models' generalizability. ... We also calculated Inception Score (IS), Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) and CLIP scores.
VLEU seeks to quantify the generalizability of T2I models by measuring the alignment between the visual text domain and the images generated by the T2I model conditioned on the visual text domain.
we also conducted a human evaluation study, where human evaluators were asked to create a variety of T2I prompts... and determine which image better adhered to the prompts

We used these pairwise comparisons to compute an Elo rating for each model, where human evaluators compared pairs of images generated by randomly selected pairs of models, without knowing which model produced which image, and determine which image better adhered to the prompts.

Additionally, we conducted a human evaluation study, where human evaluators were asked to create a variety of T2I prompts, either freely or focused on a specific subject, similar to how LLMs generate prompts. These prompts were then used to generate images with the four T2I models. The evaluators compared pairs of images generated by randomly selected pairs of models, without knowing which model produced which image, and determine which image better adhered to the prompts.
